verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents an official Mail MCP server that connects Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants to the inbox and calendar. Through it an agent can summarize and read threads, draft and send emails (with per-send user approval), and handle follow-ups across multiple Gmail and Outlook accounts. missing for 10: explicit evidence that triage actions (labeling, archiving) are exposed over MCP rather than only in-app, detailed tool/reference docs for custom agents, and independent hands-on corroboration.
